Keywords: hero, hero-centric, features, feature-rich, cta, call-to-action
Section Order: 1. Hero with headline/image, 2. Value prop, 3. Key features (3-5), 4. CTA section, 5. Footer
Color Strategy: Hero: Brand primary or vibrant. Features: Card bg #FAFAFA. CTA: Contrasting accent color
Recommended Effects: Hero parallax, feature card hover lift, CTA glow on hover
Conversion Optimization: Deep CTA placement. Use contrasting color (at least 7:1 contrast ratio). Sticky navbar CTA.

Keywords: hero, testimonials, social-proof, trust, reviews, cta
Section Order: 1. Hero, 2. Problem statement, 3. Solution overview, 4. Testimonials carousel, 5. CTA
Color Strategy: Hero: Brand color. Testimonials: Light bg #F5F5F5. CTA: Vibrant
Recommended Effects: Testimonial carousel slide animations, quote marks animations, avatar fade-in
Conversion Optimization: Social proof before CTA. Use 3-5 testimonials. Include photo + name + role. CTA after social proof.

Keywords: minimal, direct, simple, fast, straightforward, one-page
Section Order: 1. Hero with CTA, 2. Brief benefits (3), 3. Single CTA, 4. Minimal footer
Color Strategy: Monochrome or single accent. No gradient overload.
Recommended Effects: Smooth hover on CTA, subtle fade-in for text
Conversion Optimization: CTA above fold always. Minimal copy. One clear action. Fast load time priority.

Keywords: story, narrative, scroll, journey, creative, portfolio
Section Order: 1. Hook, 2. Problem, 3. Journey/Process, 4. Solution reveal, 5. Result, 6. CTA
Color Strategy: Dark-to-light or single journey color. Emotional palette.
Recommended Effects: Scroll-triggered reveals, parallax layers, section transitions
Conversion Optimization: Guide user through narrative. Each scroll step must advance the story. CTA at emotional peak.

Keywords: product, demo, interactive, try, preview, saas

Keywords: conversion, ab-test, urgency, pricing, sales, funnel
Section Order: 1. Hero with social proof, 2. Benefits, 3. Pricing, 4. FAQ, 5. Final CTA
